dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: Two reservations were completed in a single call
highlights.summary: A caller first booked a single-player round for Tuesday, then asked for a second tee time for two players on Thursday. SpeakSport found nearby alternatives to the requested 10:00 AM times and confirmed both reservations without a staff handoff.
highlights.quote: “The closest available tee time to 10:00 AM on Tuesday is 10:50 AM.” SpeakSport confirmed that booking, then completed the caller’s second reservation for Thursday at 11:00 AM.

highlights.title: Booking eligibility was checked before offering alternatives
highlights.summary: For an August 6 request, SpeakSport confirmed that the date was inside the two-week booking window, collected the playing details and offered the nearest available times when 9:00 AM was unavailable. The caller selected 8:50 AM and the reservation was completed.
highlights.quote: “August 6 is next Thursday, which is within our two-week booking window.” SpeakSport then offered 8:30, 8:40, 8:50 and 9:30 AM as alternatives.

highlights.title: A senior-rate question flowed directly into a booking
highlights.summary: SpeakSport explained when the senior special applies, gathered the caller’s preferred day, time and cart choice, and found two nearby options. The caller selected 10:50 AM and the two-player reservation was confirmed.
highlights.quote: “The senior special is available for golfers ages 55 and older, Monday through Friday from 7:30 AM to 5:50 PM, excluding holidays.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Heritage Bluffs to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
